CustomField.description: The donor's earliest known gift date from a legacy or external system (archived CRM, spreadsheet migration, prior fundraising platform). Populated once during import and preserved thereafter — NPC rollups do not touch this field. When present, formulas that determine "first gift" behavior use MIN(FirstGiftDate, FQS_Legacy_First_Gift_Date__c) so migrated donors retain their true tenure. Leave blank for donors with no pre-system giving history.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Earliest gift date from a legacy or external system. Preserved across NPC rollups so migrated donors keep their full historical tenure.
CustomField.label: Legacy First Gift Date
